outcome: Save a physical disc with its image and facts so it survives reload and can be reused.

requirements.text: Save the photo plus manufacturer, mold, and flight numbers; show a shelf tile.
Add, edit, and remove physical discs.
Survive reload and immediately use a disc in DiscCard.
Support multiple bags and bulk actions.

resume: Build save, reload, and DiscCard reuse after intake, framing, and prepared image are verified.
